source_evidence.text:
Error Analysis. To systemically analyze the short-
comings of our approach, we first select three
datasets (i.e., WebQSP, WTQ, and Spider) with
different types of structured data, and randomly
sample 100 error cases from each dataset. Then,
we manually examine these failures and classify
them into five categories:
• Selection Error: the relevant information has
not been selected by the LLM.
• Reasoning Error: given the extracted relevant
information, the LLM fails to generate the ground-
truth answer or SQL.
• Generation Format Error: the generated an-
swer is in an abnormal format that fails to be iden-
tified by our result parser.
• Hallucination: the generated results are incon-
sistent with the extracted information.
• Other Errors: other uncategorizable errors.

Figure 3: Proportions of different error types in three datasets over different types of structured data.
We show the statistics in Figure 3. First, for
the three datasets, the distributions of occurring
errors are different. In WikiSQL, the frequencies
of generation format, selection, and reasoning er-
rors are relatively uniform. Whereas, in WebQSP,
the selection error is the major error type (74%),
since the KGQA task requires selecting the most
relevant one from thousands of relations, which is
not easy work. In Spider, reasoning error occurs
more (62%), since the Text-to-SQL task requires
LLMs to generate a SQL that can be executed to
obtain the answer, which is also hard for LLMs.

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对方法归属、实体角色、实验设置与方向；未见题集须独立人工/代理语义判读。
relation_review.uncertainty: 反例题必须直接纠正错误前提或拒答越界实体，不得迎合题干伪前提。

scoring_rules.primary: SupportRecall@5; within one fact unit supporting sources are OR, required fact units are AND.
scoring_rules.answer_review: Per-case atomic reference criteria, scored 0/1 each by a named reviewer; evidence support and citation location checked separately.
scoring_rules.graph_coverage: Source-backed expected subgraphs are a reference check, not measured retrieval success or answer correctness.
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 answerable questions; 24 cross-paper relation questions reported separately; 8 negative cases reported separately.
scoring_rules.interpretation: retrieval coverage, citation validity, graph-path coverage and semantic answer correctness are separate results; no assumption that graph wins.
scoring_rules.semantic_score: Number of supported satisfied atomic criteria / all criteria. This is not calculated by source ID recall.
scoring_rules.semantic_pass: All criteria satisfied with supporting citations; no critical unsupported claim. Negatives must correct/reject the premise within the evidence boundary.
critical_errors: 伪造继承/评测/全称优越性
混淆预算耗尽与正确答案
scoring_rules.reporting: Overview, per-category metrics, charts, latency, tokens and full paired details must coexist after real execution.
